mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credentials (user_id, email, password_hash) VALUES (#{userId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, c.email, c.password_hash, u.status, c.locked_until FROM users u JOIN user_credentials c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credentials SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= 5 THEN DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ELSE locked_until END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId}
